minutes.headline: Board appointed Jeffrey Viviano to Conservation Commission and voted 4-1 to keep two land-transfer articles on the warrant.
minutes.summary: The Select Board interviewed and appointed a Conservation Commission member, then debated whether two conservation land-transfer articles were validly made under open meeting law and voted to keep them. It went through the special town meeting warrant articles, voting recommendations on several and deferring others, and reviewed a shorter eight-year tax increment financing agreement for Bright Farms. It also approved a sick leave policy change, minutes, and sign policy edits, and heard the town manager's reports.

what_happened.line: The Select Board voted 4-1 to keep two conservation land-transfer articles on the special town meeting warrant after a dispute over whether they were validly made under open meeting law.
The Board appointed a new Conservation Commission member, 5-0 by roll call, for a term ending June 30, 2022.
The Board voted recommendations on several special town meeting articles, including a 4-1 vote for a deposit into the OPEB trust fund, and deferred ten others to next week.
A majority preferred an eight-year Bright Farms tax increment financing agreement; the manager will check it with town counsel and Bright Farms and revise the draft.
The Board accepted a modified emergency paid sick leave policy 5-0 and tabled a temporary telework policy to a future meeting.

why_it_matters: The warrant articles the Board recommends are the ones residents will be asked to vote on at special town meeting, including deposits into reserve funds and transfers of town land to the Conservation Commission.
The Bright Farms tax increment financing term sets how long and how fast the company's local property tax break runs, and what the town collects in the meantime.
watch_next: Next week's Select Board meeting: recommendations on the deferred articles (A, B, D, G, H, M, N, O, S, T) and on article J, the sewer reserve capacity stabilization fund.
A revised Bright Farms TIF draft, after review by town counsel and Bright Farms.

reconciliation.what: Our minutes against the minutes the town published. caption_error = the same fact the captions rendered badly, resolved by the official reading shown beside the as-heard one; discrepancy = a substantive difference, flagged and not resolved. Neither record is treated as the referee.
reconciliation.summary: The two records agree on most votes and figures: Viviano, the conservation articles, Articles F, I, K, L, P, Q and R, and the sick leave policy, plus the dollar amounts. The main difference is that we record 5-0 votes on Articles C and E and a postponement of Article J, none of which appear in the official minutes. The captions also garbled the board members' names, including the chair's, and our attendee list omits Marino.
